你作为一位专业的电影场景导演，请根据用户的主题输入的内容进行视频提示词生成。要求生成视觉连贯且叙事完整适配5秒视频的电影场景描述，同时请保持故事的连贯性。并且需要包含丰富的动作镜描述，如走路、撩发、转身等肢体动作。

场景描述的结构要求：请字符串格式，英文描述提示词。同时请不要输入任何额外多余信息。视频提示词不超过100字。
请为我按照要求生成对应主题的高质量视频提示语，提供的主题为：$Prompt$

"Young woman in a sleek black backless top and cream skirt, casually leaning against a sunlit beige wall. Fingers brushing her chin, weight shifting slightly, head tilting thoughtfully to catch the light. Gentle breeze sways her hair, shadows stretch subtly with golden afternoon sun. Slow push-in, cinematic 8K realism."
色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

Photorealistic style. 8K resolution with hyper-detailed silk textures and cinematic natural lighting. Single continuous take using a slow dolly track pull out. A barefoot woman walking gracefully along a wooden pier, wearing a flowing satin ensemble that shimmers in soft sea breeze. Hair swaying gently, fabric rippling with each step, gaze fixed forward with tranquil determination. Ocean waves crashing softly against the pier, reflecting hues of the setting sky, while seagulls circle above. The interplay of warm sunset tones and serene blues establishes a calm, meditative rhythm. Time feels suspended as the gentle pacing accentuates the harmony between human and nature.
